title: Blurry
text: Blurry. A WASTE OF MONEY!!!!! I just received my pillow. I'm really upset because 1#..I waited 3 weeks to get to ME........2#.. I can't gift this to my mother for christmas... It's so blurry......... 3# you telling me I paid 30.00 for this PILLOW CASE and it's blurry.

product_metadata.title: Custom Personalized Flip Reversible Sequin Pillow Cover Empty DIY Throw Case Decorative Home Decor with Your Personal Photo, Text, or Logo - Gift For Him, her, Christmas, Birthday, Holiday (Champagne)
features: To begin your order simply click "Customize Now" and begin adding your text or upload your personal logo
Printable space is 10.5" X 15" Not Full Image Bleed
Sequins reverse easy from simply running your hand over the surface. Create your own look with a personalized pattern!
Case is made out of a high quality polyester which is visible on its back side.
description: This reversible sequin pillow case dresses up any room and adds a bit of flair to its surroundings! The shimmering effect flips easy to showcase your personal image and a solid color or your choice. Only one side of this case shimmers and is reversible. Please note that this is the case only and an actual pillow insert is not included.
